_doc: What each gate case's label must say, from facts checked on the episode's frames. A key matches episode names by fnmatch. outcome: the outcome must be one of these. align: the goal alignment's relation must be one of these. issue: a data issue whose category matches one of these patterns, at severity sev or above when sev is given. mistake: an operator mistake whose category matches. named: words that must appear in what the timeline, key events, tasks or summary say is handled. held: named must appear as a handled object and not_named must never be claimed as one. max_issue_sev: no data issue above this severity. why is the fact on the frames.
